page.content:
Mlok is a fictional entity in the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character was originally created by Gary Myers for his short story "The Priest of Mlok".

page.overview:
What is Mlok?

Mlok is a fictional entity in the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character was originally created by Gary Myers for his short story "The Priest of Mlok".

Mlok is a creature, possibly a Great Old One, who landed on Earth in ancient times somewhere near the Bnazic Desert, known to devour human victims for sustenance. (: "The Priest of Mlok")

A bloody cult was created around Mlok and it became strong in the city of Drinen. (: "The Gods of Drinen", "The Tomb of Neb")
